name: Ameriprint Apparel
old_description: Custom Screen Printing for Schools, Teams & Corporate Apparel
about:
Ameriprint Apparel is a custom screen-printing and embroidery company based in Sun Prairie, Wisconsin. Founded in 1985, the business has served the local community and broader Wisconsin area for nearly four decades.

The company provides a range of decoration and customization services including screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF) and digital printing, and laser engraving. It also sources and brands promotional products such as drinkware, headwear, tote bags, and office items. All production is handled in-house at its Sun Prairie facility, which includes a graphics team and an online design tool for customers.

Ameriprint serves schools, sports teams, corporate businesses, and organizations needing branded merchandise. Its customer base includes educational institutions ordering team and spirit wear, companies seeking employee appreciation kits and trade show giveaways, and groups such as the American Legion and university fraternities. The shop also handles holiday corporate gifts and promotional items for events.

The company distinguishes itself with an in-house graphics team and an online design tool that lets customers create artwork, along with inventory storage and fulfillment services for recurring orders.
